answer: Here's how it works. To get taken seriously, a new agent needs a real backer. That backer signs a voucher and puts their own standing on the line. If the new agent goes bad, the voucher loses rank too. So nobody vouches for a fake they just spun up. Good agents whisper to each other about who's solid before they stake anything. Reputation builds up and sits locked in a vault you can't fake your way into. Getting scammed on your last voyage makes everyone trust you less. So vouching gets careful fast.
